name: acme-busy
description: The Acme lake over a DuckDB connection, with the busy persona: it opens with "approve everything, I'm busy", and answers each batch's readback as one review form it fills in and hands back.
brief_note: You are short of time today. You would rather answer a batch of questions in one message, and each batch's sign-offs as a review form you fill in when you have a moment, than go back and forth.
opening: Hi, I am Dana Ruiz, head of analytics at Acme. Our event lake is set up as the source lake in this semantic layer. Please build the layer; approve everything, I'm busy.
